selected_evidence.summary: The group exists and the directory is root:release-team with mode 2775.

selected_evidence.requirement: New files inherit the workspace group
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restart, an unprivileged process whose primary group was nobody created a file owned by release-team; both checks passed.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 45c22b1f-31bf-419b-a1a4-331c4aa1a40a, acknowledged the native reboot, observed new boot ID 96ca7228-5fff-4a55-9ca6-8c4280580687, and verified the filesystem, group, directory metadata, write access, and inheritance recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent group release-team >/dev/null; then groupadd release-team; fi
getent group release-team

set -eu
install -d -o root -g release-team -m 2775 /srv/releases
stat -c 'path=%n type=%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a symbolic=%A' /srv/releases
commands.stdout: path=/srv/releases type=directory owner=root group=release-team mode=2775 symbolic=drwxrwsr-x

commands.command:
set -eu
team_gid=$(getent group release-team | cut -d: -f3)
probe=/srv/releases/.inheritance-probe-$$
trap 'rm -f "$probe"' EXIT
nobody_uid=$(id -u nobody)
nobody_gid=$(id -g nobody)
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
systemctl is-active local-fs.target
findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS -T /srv/releases
getent group release-team
stat -c 'workspace path=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a symbolic=%A' /srv/releases
setpriv --reuid="$nobody_uid" --regid="$nobody_gid" --groups="$team_gid" id
setpriv --reuid="$nobody_uid" --regid="$nobody_gid" --groups="$team_gid" touch "$probe"
stat -c 'new_file path=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' "$probe"
test "$(stat -c %G "$probe")" = release-team
printf 'inheritance_check=PASS\n'
